name: smith behind neck press
description: On the smith machine, you press the bar overhead from behind your neck. Works the shoulders and triceps, so keep it controlled.
instructions: Set an upright bench in the smith machine so the bar runs just behind your head.
Sit with your back against the pad and grip the bar wider than your shoulders.
Unrack the bar and lower it behind your neck.
Press it straight up until your arms are extended.
Lower slowly to the back of your neck and repeat.
